The willow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The signal is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the reef. The design leans on slashing penalties scaled strictly exponentially relative to collateral ratio.
